construction_notes.text: City of San Jose permit PD21-012 (Planned Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2021), status Approved, issue date 2022-08-30: "Planned Development Permit to allow the removal of three ordinance-size trees and the construction of 21 single-family residences and 14 accessory dwelling units, including four affordable units, on an approximately 2.85-gross acre site. Includes extended" (city text cut off at 255 characters)
Parcel: the city record's APN 984-45-006 is not a county parcel; this is the county parcel at 1975 Cambrianna Dr.
Marketed by Robson Homes as Rose Lane, 21 single-family homes. Homes carry LaNelle Pl addresses (3208 to 3298 LaNelle Pl) in the state report.
State report 2025 lists certificates of occupancy for 17 homes on LaNelle Pl between 2025-02-14 and 2025-07-17, plus ADU certificates of occupancy on the same street.
State report 2022 entitlement rows for PD21-012: 21 SFD units approved 2022-04-21 and 14 ADUs approved 2022-08-09.

San Jose Spotlight: site of about 3 acres on a 10-acre Cambrian School District campus closed nearly 50 years earlier; the district sells the land for about $10 million per its finance head; Mayor Liccardo cast the only no vote at Council approval.
Later city permit adjustments: AD23-538 regulatory agreement (approved 2024-02-14), AD23-580 floor plan and elevation changes (approved 2023-12-21), AD24-657 and AD25-086 lot-level design changes.
